name: leg_sugar_50hz
what: tarsal sweet gustatory receptor neurons driven at 50 Hz: each LgLG4 and LgAG2 cell gets an independent Poisson train of membrane kicks for the whole trial (as scripts/assay_pathways.py --assay legsugar_mn9 --rates 50 gives it)
evidence: LgLG4 (Gr64f+/Ir56b+) and LgAG2 (Gr61a+) match tarsal sweet GRN projections (male-CNS taste connectome, bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.08.25.671814; measured identity). 50 Hz is the 'real sugar rate' of the 6 Oct 00:41 check, a protocol choice, not a fly quantity
notes: t_off_ms null = to the end of the trial. kick_mv 'profile' = the profile's kick_mv. The Poisson draws come from numpy default_rng(seed + the protocol's stimulus_rng_offset), one uniform per stimulated cell per step while the event is on
